children: Japanese stocks may decline as concerns about higher energy costs continue following overnight gains in crude oil prices. Nikkei futures are down 1.0% at 68375 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.08 yen, compared with Y158.14 as of Thursday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on updates on Hurricane Isaias, developments in the Iran conflict and their implications for oil prices. The Nikkei Stock Average fell 1.4% to 69042.11 on Thursday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
